assumptions: Storefront covers both indoor and outdoor plants — category field on Plant entity covers both.
Subscription feature is in scope as a customer-facing monthly/quarterly box.
Admin panel is in scope for plant, order, and inventory management.
Custom headless architecture assumed — no third-party e-commerce platform dependency.
Wholesale/B2B persona is out of scope for this plan.
Single currency (USD) and single language (English) for this version.
Cart is stored server-side per customer as a JSONB items array for simplicity.
Grow-zone validation on checkout is logged but not a hard blocker in v1.
Pet-safe flag is prominently surfaced as a filter and badge on plant cards.
OrderItem and Cart marked internal:true — they are system join/session tables not directly surfaced as standalone user-facing pages.
Variant marked internal:true — PlantSizeVariant is the canonical size-variant entity surfaced via /admin/plants/[id]/variants.
Customer entity surfaced via /customers list page for admin management; internal flag removed.
/login and /signup pages use archetype:form (auth pages) not archetype:list to avoid dataSource requirement.
InviteAdmin workflow inputs declared explicitly: email and name collected from the admins-new form page.
DeletePlantWorkflow plantId source corrected to route param 'id' rather than auth claim.
description: An online plant storefront where customers browse, filter, and purchase indoor/outdoor plants with pot options, care guides, and optional subscription delivery.
